caption:
Feel too young or overlooked to be taken seriously? Let your life answer. (1 Timothy 4:12 devotional)

“Let no one despise your youth” — and then Paul says how: be an example. Trust isn't demanded by age or title; it seeps out of ordinary word, conduct, love, and faith. Your life speaks louder than your credentials.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — where do you feel overlooked right now?
